# LTX-2.5 05 — 10S Face Identity Reinforcer

Face-preservation workflow based on the user's working LTX-2.5 INT8 ConvRot graph. Prompt enhancement is OFF so text does not fight the image identity. Reference image is the identity authority.

Drop/replace the image in the green AVATAR node if needed.

nodes.title: SCRIPT / VIDEO REQUEST — ONE PROMPT
widgets_values: Use the provided first frame as the visual source. The news presenter holds almost still for a brief beat, then speaks calmly to camera. Motion is minimal: natural blinking, tiny eye movements, subtle breathing, localized lip and jaw articulation, and very small head movements only. Keep the head predominantly frontal and the camera completely fixed. No profile view, no large smile, no exaggerated mouth opening, no hand or object crossing the face, no zoom, no reframing, no cut, and no change of wardrobe, materials, lighting, or facial identity. If requested motion conflicts with the source likeness, reduce motion.

widgets_values:
# MAXIMUM FACE-LOCK RESEARCH BUILD

This graph fixes three major weaknesses in the earlier workflow:
1. Identity reference is a separate face/bust crop, not the UI screenshot/full-body frame.
2. The BASE sampler gets attention-level reference conditioning in addition to normal I2V frame-0 conditioning.
3. It restores LTX-2.5's native two-stage path: stage-1 0.7 image hold → latent x2 → source image re-hold at 1.0 → official 3-step refine.

IMPORTANT: identity patching is BASE PASS ONLY. The refine guider is fed directly from the unpatched UNET loader. Reference attention in the re-noise/refine pass can smear face colors; the original source image is instead re-injected at strength 1.0.

The bundled avatar crops came from a low-resolution UI screenshot. Replace BOTH green image nodes with the original clean, high-resolution avatar still for best identity.
